period_note: Year-end position for Social Islami Bank Limited, Solo/Standalone basis (reporting_basis determined by matching this dataset's stored figures against the bank's own Solo-labeled Balance Sheet / 'Only Bank-Solo Basis' Highlights annexure / Note 16.5 'Capital Adequacy (Solo Basis)', as distinct from the parallel Consolidated Balance Sheet covering SIBL and its two wholly-owned subsidiaries, SIBL Securities Limited and SIBL Investment Limited). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments (General)' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances, and 'Classified Investments' / 'Ratio of Classified Investments to Total Investments' is the equivalent of NPL / NPL ratio -- mapped to this dataset's gross_loans and npl_pct fields for cross-bank comparability, consistent with the convention already used for EXIMBANK, FIRSTSBANK and GIB in this dataset. Source: own Directors' Report Tier-I/Tier-II Capital Base comparative table lines ~4415-4460 (own report, FY2017 vs FY2016); Annexure-H 'Highlights of Performance (Only Bank-Solo Basis)' comparative column in FY2018 report lines ~15670-15695; 'SIBL at a Glance' 5-year table in FY2018 and FY2019 reports.
